status: design-locked v1 (batch-4 slice 4c-i); governed semantics CONST-PINNED (whitelist/floors/disqualifiers/§13.1 anchors), calibration = reviewed schema+preset version bump; threshold VALUES = initial §13.1 #2 priors, NOT validated alpha

notes.scope: Pass1 cheap-eligibility ONLY (exchange / price / ADV / market-cap / basic-status, FMP-profile-cheap). It is a fast pre-filter, NOT the authoritative safety gate: the Pass2 audit-safety-gate reuses engine/us_short_hard_veto.py (§5.1) and is not defined here. A cheap-eligible ticker still goes through Pass2 hard veto.
notes.thresholds: min_price_usd / min_adv_usd / min_market_cap_usd are INITIAL §13.1 #2 priors (US-short is active-only; historical backtests cannot prove alpha), NOT a tuned/validated set. $5 floor avoids sub-$5 microstructure; $5M/day dollar-ADV and $300M market-cap are conservative liquidity/size floors. The v1 priors (and the whitelist / disqualifier set / §13.1 anchors) are CONST-PINNED in the schema: forward-calibration is a deliberate REVIEWED schema+preset version bump (semver), never a silent value edit — so the gate cannot weaken (lower floors / drop a disqualifier / admit OTC / re-route a calibration anchor) without review.
notes.exchange_whitelist: canonical NYSE/NASDAQ per §4.0 active-only; the slice 4c-ii predicate normalizes the provider exchange string to these. Extend (e.g. NYSE American) only via a reviewed governance change.
notes.candidate_set: Pass1 narrows full universe to a candidate set ('几百只', §4.0); its size cap = §13.1 #19 prior, set by slice 4c-ii / batch5 within the FMP call budget (SR-PROVIDER-001).
notes.catalyst_recall: real market-level feed (earnings beats / rating changes / 8-K) = batch5 (§18.2); slice 4c-ii wires only the injection slot. criteria/size = §13.1 #21 prior.
notes.boundary: pure/offline contract; no provider/live/network/DataHub; no A-share crossing; thresholds never imply ship-gate/full-size eligibility.
